record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain the incumbent pointwise logistic loss but normalize it within each sequence over nonpadding targets, then average across the batch. Current global token averaging gives longer sampled histories more influence; equal sequence weighting may better match evaluation over users. Preserve positive/negative loss terms, sampling, model, readout, optimizer, scheduler and batch/epoch settings. This tests weighting without repeating the regressed BPR replacement.

category_rationales.rationale: Test equal weighting of nonempty sequences across all four datasets by averaging the existing pointwise logistic loss within each sequence before averaging sequences. This may better match user-averaged evaluation. Only loss reduction changes; model and predictor remain compatible.
